Graduate
Graduate Students in the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering at the University of Kentucky collaborate with faculty researchers to create technological advances that improve everyday life and change the world for the better.
ECE has graduate programs leading to:
Master's Degree (MS) in Electrical Engineering
Doctoral Degree (PhD) in Electrical Engineering
Master's Degree (MS) in Computer Engineering (jointly with CS Department)
Doctoral Degree (PhD) in Computer Engineering (jointly with CS Department)
Graduate Certificate in Power and Energy
Online Graduate Certificate in Power Systems
Our graduate programs offer opportunities to participate in cutting edge research with world-class faculty! Research and teaching assistantships are available – apply today!
Electrical and Computer Engineering drives the technologies that power our world today and will define the possibilities of tomorrow. A graduate degree from UK ECE prepares you to lead — whether in industry, academia, or innovation — by giving you deep expertise, meaningful research experience, and a supportive community of faculty and peers invested in your success.
Dr. Daniel L. Lau
Director of Graduate Studies
